body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose yourself or one ally within 4 units. The target gains +1 die on its next Action or Reaction before your next turn.

surges.html: The bonus die remains available until used or the encounter ends.
The target also gains +1 Movement until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: TIME THREAD
rider.html: After resolving this Action, create a Thread. Consume this Thread after a timed effect you created would end to extend it until the end of the current turn.
